# Preamble

```{r}
# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(brms)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
# Relative working directory
active_wd <- function(x, output = FALSE) {
    rdir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
    rdir <- sub("[^/]*$", "", rdir)
    rdir <- paste0(rdir, x)
    setwd(rdir)
    if (output == TRUE) {
        return(getwd())
    }
}
active_wd("data")
# Load in data
data2 <- read_csv("combined_data.csv")
data2 <- data2[data2$exp == 2 & data2$type == "Heterogenous",]
reversals <- 4
```

# Data prep

```{r}
# Select final 4 reversals in each staircase for each Participant
last_revs <- data.frame()
for (i in unique(data2$Participant)) {
    for (j in unique(data2$start_id)) {
        for (k in unique(data2$type)) {
            for (l in unique(data2$envelope_1)) {
                for (m in unique(data2$repetition)) {
                    for (n in unique(data2$direction)) {
                        rev <- subset(data2, Participant == i & type == k & envelope_1 == l & repetition == m & direction == n & l_reversal == 1)
                        if (!j %in% rev$start_id) next
                        rev <- subset(rev, start_id == j)
                        num <- length(rev$l_reversal) - reversals
                        rev <- rev[-c(1:num), ]
                        last_revs <- rbind(last_revs, rev)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Categorise each reversal
k <- 1
for (i in 1:nrow(last_revs)) {
    if (k > reversals) k <- 1
    last_revs$trial_num[i] <- k
    k <- k + 1
}

# Group and condense response/reversal data
revs <- last_revs %>%
    group_by(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num) %>%
    summarise("Level" = mean(second - first)) %>%
    mutate("trial_num" = as.integer(trial_num), "start_id" = factor(start_id)) %>%
    arrange(Participant, start_id, direction, envelope_1, type, repetition, trial_num)

# Calculate PSE for each standard and envelope for each participant (and Z scores)
pse <- revs %>%
    group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition) %>%
    summarise("PSE" = mean(Level))

pse$PSEtotal <- 0
pse$standard <- 0
for (i in 1:length(unique(pse$envelope_1))) {
    for (j in 1:length(unique(pse$start_id))) {
        e <- unique(pse$envelope_1)[i]
        if (!j %in% unique(pse$start_id[pse$envelope_1 == e])) next
        pse$PSEtotal[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- data2$first[data2$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & data2$start_id == j] + pse$PSE[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j]
        pse$standard[pse$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & pse$start_id == j] <- data2$first[data2$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & data2$start_id == j]
    }
}

envelopes2 <- data.frame("Participant" = pse$Participant, "start_id" = pse$start_id, "envelope_1" = pse$envelope_1, "type" = pse$type, "repetition" = pse$repetition, "Flat" = 0, "Percussive" = 0)

for (i in 1:length(pse$Participant)) {
    envelopes2$Flat[i] <- ifelse(pse$envelope_1[i] == "flat", pse$standard[i], pse$PSEtotal[i])
}
for (i in 1:length(pse$Participant)) {
    envelopes2$Percussive[i] <- ifelse(pse$envelope_1[i] == "perc", pse$standard[i], pse$PSEtotal[i])
}
envelopes2$delta <- envelopes2$Percussive - envelopes2$Flat
envelopes2$Participant <- factor(envelopes2$Participant)
envelopes2$start_id <- factor(envelopes2$start_id)
envelopes2$envelope_1 <- factor(envelopes2$envelope_1)
envelopes2$repetition <- factor(envelopes2$repetition)
```

# Staircase figure

```{r}
# Prep for staircase figures
discrep2 <- revs %>%
    group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition, direction) %>%
    summarise("PSE" = mean(Level)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = PSE) %>%
    # mutate(jnd = (abs(Above) + abs(Below)) / 2) |>
    mutate(discrepency = abs(Above - Below))

ycoords <- revs %>%
    group_by(Participant, start_id, envelope_1, type, repetition, direction) %>%
    summarise("PSE" = mean(Level)) %>%
    mutate("coord" = "Y")
xcoords <- ycoords
xcoords$coord <- "X"
coords <- rbind(ycoords, xcoords) %>%
    arrange(envelope_1) %>%
    arrange(start_id) %>%
    arrange(Participant) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = coord, values_from = PSE)
coords <- coords[rep(seq_len(nrow(coords)), each = 2), ]
coords$X <- rep_len(c(0, 95, 95, 0), length.out = nrow(coords))
for (i in 1:length(unique(pse$envelope_1))) {
    for (j in 1:length(unique(pse$start_id))) {
        e <- unique(pse$envelope_1)[i]
        if (!j %in% unique(pse$start_id[pse$envelope_1 == e])) next
        coords$Y[coords$envelope_1 == unique(pse$envelope_1)[i] & coords$start_id == j] <- data2$first[data2$envelope_1 == unique(coords$envelope_1)[i] & data2$start_id == j] + coords$Y[coords$envelope_1 == unique(coords$envelope_1)[i] & coords$start_id == j]
    }
}

minmax <- c()
for (i in unique(coords$Participant)) {
    for (j in unique(coords$start_id)) {
        for (k in unique(coords$envelope_1)) {
            for (l in unique(coords$repetition)) {
                for (m in unique(coords$type)) {
                    above <- max(data2$trial_num[data2$Participant == i & data2$start_id == j & data2$envelope_1 == k & data2$repetition == l & data2$type == m & data2$direction == "Above"])
                    below <- max(data2$trial_num[data2$Participant == i & data2$start_id == j & data2$envelope_1 == k & data2$repetition == l & data2$type == m & data2$direction == "Below"])
                    minmax <- c(above, below)
                    coords$X[coords$Participant == i & coords$start_id == j & coords$envelope_1 == k & coords$repetition == l & coords$type == m] <- ifelse(
                        coords$X[coords$Participant == i & coords$start_id == j & coords$envelope_1 == k & coords$repetition == l & coords$type == m] == 0,
                        min(minmax),
                        max(minmax)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```{r}
# Create staircase figures for each participant in each session
u <- 1
for (i in unique(data2$Participant)) {
    for (j in unique(data2$start_id)) {
        maxt <- max(data2$trial_num[data2$Participant == i & data2$start_id == j])
        data2 %>%
            filter(Participant == i & start_id == j) %>%
            ggplot(aes(trial_num, second, color = direction, shape = envelope_1)) +
            geom_path(alpha = 0.3) +
            # geom_point(aes(fill = factor(l_reversal), shape = envelope_1), color = "black", pch = 21) +
            geom_point() +
            theme_classic() +
            geom_hline(
                aes(yintercept = first),
                linetype = 1,
                alpha = 0.3
            ) +
            geom_hline(
                data = pse[pse$Participant == i & pse$start_id == j, ],
                aes(yintercept = PSEtotal),
                linetype = 2,
                alpha = 0.5,
                color = "purple"
            ) +
            geom_polygon(
                data = coords[coords$Participant == i & coords$start_id == j, ],
                mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y, group = envelope_1),
                fill = "brown",
                alpha = 0.3
            ) +
            geom_text(
                data = pse[pse$Participant == i & pse$start_id == j, ],
                aes(label = paste("PSE =", round(PSEtotal, 2), "dB")),
                x = maxt - 10,
                y = 0,
                hjust = "left",
                inherit.aes = FALSE
            ) +
            geom_text(
                data = pse[pse$Participant == i & pse$start_id == j, ],
                aes(label = paste("Delta =", round(PSE, 2), "dB")),
                x = maxt - 10,
                y = -5,
                hjust = "left",
                inherit.aes = FALSE
            ) +
            geom_text(
                data = discrep2[discrep2$Participant == i & discrep2$start_id == j, ],
                aes(label = paste("Window size =", round(discrepency, 2), "dB")),
                x = maxt - 10,
                y = -10,
                hjust = "left",
                inherit.aes = FALSE
            ) +
            ggtitle("Trials across each staircase") +
            xlab("Trials") +
            ylab("Comparitor Pitch (cents)") +
            ylim(c(-80, 0)) +
            facet_wrap(vars(repetition, envelope_1),
                nrow = 4,
                ncol = 2
            ) +
            scale_shape_manual("Comparitor envelope",
                labels = c("Flat", "Percussive"),
                values = c("square", "triangle")
            ) +
            scale_color_manual(
                "Comparitor starting position",
                values = c("red", "blue")
            )
            # scale_fill_manual(
            #     "Reversal",
            #     labels = c("No", "Yes"),
            #     values = c("cyan", "orange")
            # )
        name <- paste("staircase_p", i, "_", j, ".pdf", sep = "")
        ggsave(name, width = 20, height = 8)
        cat(u, "\n")
        u <- u + 1
    }
}
```

# Model selection

```{r}
# Random effects

priors <- c(
    prior(cauchy(0,2), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
    prior(cauchy(1,1), class = "b", coef = "Flat"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "envelope_1perc"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "repetition2"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "Flat:envelope_1perc"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "Flat:repetition2"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "envelope_1perc:repetition2"),
    prior(cauchy(0,1), class = "b", coef = "Flat:envelope_1perc:repetition2")
)

model <- brm(
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1 * repetition + (1 + Flat|Participant),
    data = envelopes2,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 30000,
    warmup = 20000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9999, max_treedepth = 18)
)

model2 <- brm( # THE BEST
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1 * repetition + (1|Participant),
    data = envelopes2,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 30000,
    warmup = 20000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999)
)
bf21 <- log(bayes_factor(model2, model)$bf, 10)
model3 <- model2

model2 <- brm(
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1 * repetition + (0 + Flat|Participant),
    data = envelopes2,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 30000,
    warmup = 20000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 20)
)
bf22 <- log(bayes_factor(model2, model)$bf, 10)

model2 <- brm(
    Percussive ~ 0 + Intercept + Flat * envelope_1 * repetition,
    data = envelopes2,
    seed = 1,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = priors,
    iter = 30000,
    warmup = 20000,
    thin = 1,
    chains = 10,
    cores = 10,
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 20)
)
bf23 <- log(bayes_factor(model2, model)$bf, 10)
model <- model3
```

# Model comparison figure (Exp2)

```{r}
# Bayes factors for RE comparisons
bf2adf <- data.frame(
    model = factor(c(2, 3, 4)),
    bflog = c(bf21, bf22, bf23),
    select = factor(c(1,0,0)),
    stage = "(bold(I))~Random~effects"
)
# Bayes factors for FE comparisons
bf2bdf <- data.frame(
    model = factor(c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)),
    bflog = c(bf24, bf25, bf26, bf27, bf28, bf29, bf2a),
    select = factor(c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)),
    stage = "(bold(II))~Fixed~effects"
)
# Bayes factors for IS comparisons
bf2cdf <- data.frame(
    model = factor(c(2, 3, 4)),
    bflog = c(bf2b, bf2c, bf2d),
    select = factor(c(0, 1, 0)),
    stage = "(bold(III))~Intercept/Slope"
)
# All together BF
bfall2 <- rbind(bf2adf, bf2bdf, bf2cdf)

fig1pan2 <- bfall2 |>  
    ggplot(aes(bflog, factor(model, level = sort(levels(model), decreasing = T)), color = select)) +
    theme_classic() +
    xlim(-6,6) +
    scale_color_manual("Selected", values = c("#ab2727", "#4f852c"), labels = c("No","Yes")) +
    geom_point(pch = 16, size = 3) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = factor(model, level = sort(levels(model), decreasing = T)))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
    labs(x = expression(log[10](italic(BF))), y = expression(Model), title = expression((bold(B))~Experiment~2)) +
    facet_wrap(~stage, ncol = 1, nrow = 3, labeller = label_parsed, scales = "free_y") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig1pan2
# ggsave("bfall2.svg", width = 5, height = 5)
```

```{r}

fig1pan1 + fig1pan2 + plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect", guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Regression figure (Exp 2)

```{r}
draws1 <- as_draws_df(final_model2)[,1]
set.seed(1)
draws1 <- draws1[sample(1:100000, 1000, replace = TRUE),]
lines1 <- data.frame(
    int = draws1$b_Intercept
)
main1 <- summary(final_model2)$fixed[1,1]

fig2pan3 <- ggplot() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0.5), lim = c(-60, -20)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0.5), lim = c(-60, -20)) +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = main1) +
    geom_abline(data = lines1, aes(intercept = int, slope = 1), alpha = 0.01) +
    labs(x = "Flat (dB)", y = "Percussive (dB)", title = expression((bold(B))~Experiment~2)) +
    annotate("text", x = -35, y = -58, label = "italic(R^2) == 0.98", parse = TRUE, size = 6, hjust = "left") +
    annotate("text", x = -35, y = -54, label = "italic(y == x - 2.03)", parse = TRUE, size = 6, hjust = "left")
fig2pan3
# ggsave("reg2.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
```
